text:
olivia_csm: Heads-up — VP Eng at Alderly (ALDR-824) stepped down this morning. Their sandbox/org shows ~60% drop in API usage over the last 7d. Renewal in ~6 weeks. I flagged a potential competitor pilot (BlazeAI) in procurement notes. Need quick triage and a short play to stabilize usage and surface exec contacts.

kevin_ae: Thanks — when was last call/POC demo? any notes from the champion?

olivia_csm: Last touch was 3/8; champion (Sanjay, dir of ML) is on PTO til next Tue. Procurement reached out to sales rep about pricing alignment 2 days ago.

jamie_eng: Quick check on our side: deployment logs show long tail of successful requests but a spike of 403s ~72hrs ago for a service token. Might explain client-side retries. I ran a quick query:
```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE account = 'ALDR-824' AND ts > now() - interval '7 days';
-- result: 420 -> prior week: 1050
```
noah_support: Created ticket SUP-9342 for the 403s and linked account. We pushed a temporary TTL reset for the known token for a small cohort. Noah noted they also have a rate-limit alert configured that hit twice.

maria_success_ops: Noted. Any sign of data migration or infra change on their side?

jamie_eng: Not in our logs, looks client-side. Could be an SDK upgrade or config roll. I'll reach out to dev contact (copied in earlier thread: dev@alderly.com) and ask for recent deploys.

kevin_ae: For the renewal: propose 1) immediate enablement + 2hr deep-dive with new Eng lead + champion, 2) 30d trial extension with tagged TAM support, 3) quick ROI deck and call with CFO/Procurement. I can own the exec ask if CS provides deck + usage delta analysis.

olivia_csm: Agree. I can draft the ROI + usage slide. Jamie, can you give a 1-slide note on the 403/root-cause once SUP-9342 lands? Noah, please confirm the fix and whether we should remove rate-limit for their seat temporarily.

noah_support: Will confirm in SUP-9342. Temp fix applied; rolling monitor for 24h, will remove limits if stable.

jamie_eng: Will add 1-slide RCA and dev checklist. Also can provide a short troubleshooting playbook they can run during the call (token rotation, SDK pin).

olivia_csm: I'll schedule a 45min triage + enablement call for Tue 10am PT (tentative) and prep a short ask email for the new Eng lead + CFO.

kevin_ae: +1. I'll prepare an extension offer and executive invite. Also flagging competitive intel: reach out to partner for win themes vs BlazeAI.

maria_success_ops: I'll capture the action items and add to the renewal tracker: assign TAM, SUP-9342 link, triage call, ROI slide, 30d extension offer.

olivia_csm: Action items: 1) Jamie: RCA slide + dev checklist by EOD today, 2) Noah: confirm SUP-9342 status and stability by EOD, 3) Olivia: ROI slide + schedule call, 4) Kevin: extension + exec invite. Goal: move from risk -> mitigate before next week. :thumbsup:
